name: refined-gemini
description: Align Google Gemini Web UI 1:1 with ChatGPT Web typography, color surfaces, and clean layout (Manifest V3 Extension & UserScript).
author: Quiyyy

scripts.build: npm run build:icons && npm run build:userscript
scripts.check: node --check src/defaults.js && node --check src/content.js && node --check src/sandbox.js && node --check src/popup/popup.js && node --check userscript/refined-gemini.user.js
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run check && node scripts/pack-extension.mjs
